newsitem.title: CHINA: China Petrochemical profits up 7.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China Petrochemical profits up 7.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: China National Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) recorded pre-tax profits of 31.28 billion yuan ($3.77 billion) in 1996, up 7.5 percent from 1995, the Economic Daily said on Wednesday.
The state-owned refiner had said in December it expected to post 7.0 billion yuan in profits for 1996 after paying about 24.5 billion yuan in taxes.
Sinopec's sales reached 213.97 billion yuan in 1996, up 5.0 percent over the previous year, the newspaper said.
Sinopec faced tough market conditions because of price rises for domestic onshore oil and higher costs for coal, electric power and transport, it said.
Prices of imported crude oil and domestic offshore oil also surged last year, and the firm faced fierce competition from foreign companies.
Weak domestic demand for petrochemical products led to falling prices last year.
